key_insight: The paper shows that for Z_N Abelian lattice gauge theories with N a power of two, the gauge-invariant subspace can be enforced by “binary Gauss stabilizers,” an alternative stabilizer set to the usual Gauss operators.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical way to build error-correcting codes and perform gauge fixing that exploits existing gauge symmetries without adding extra qubits.
method: Construct stabilizers for the gauge-invariant subspace of discrete Abelian lattice gauge theories.
Specialize the construction to Z_N groups with N = 2^k so the constraints can be expressed in a binary-friendly form.
Use the resulting stabilizer group for code design and an alternative gauge-fixing strategy.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a theoretical construction and application study, but does not mention numerical benchmarks or experimental validation.
watch_item: The approach is limited to Abelian Z_N theories with N a power of two, so its direct applicability to non-Abelian or non-binary cases is unclear.
paper_title: Binary Gauss Stabilizers for Abelian Lattice Gauge Theories
